content.goal: Univer is an Office SDK for embedding Office editing capabilities—spreadsheets, documents, slides, canvases, and PDFs (including Sheets and Docs)—into a developer's own application. It provides editing, calculation, collaboration, and file-processing building blocks for people and agents, using the application's own data and permissions.
content.usage: Install with `pnpm add @univerjs/presets @univerjs/preset-sheets-core` in a Vite-based browser project, add a container element, call `createUniver` with the Sheets Core preset, then run `univerAPI.createWorkbook({})` to render an editable spreadsheet.
content.pros: The repository's open-source Web SDK core—content models, formula and rendering engines, Facade APIs, UI foundation, and Sheets/Docs editing—is licensed under Apache-2.0 and reusable in commercial applications. Features split into content-logic and UI plugins with explicit dependency declarations, giving custom features clear boundaries and consistent extension points.
content.cons: Older or non-standard environments may need a polyfill for `Intl.Segmenter`; developing the monorepo itself requires Node.js >=22.18, while Headless usage needs Node.js >=18.17.0, suggesting some runtime setup may be required depending on target environment. Commercial Web SDK plugins, Server SDK, and AI SDK extensions are licensed separately, and freemium evaluation includes watermarks and feature limits.
content.fit: Univer appears suited to teams building browser-based Office editing features with bundlers like Vite, esbuild, or Webpack 5, targeting Chrome >=88, Edge >=90, Firefox >=88, Safari >=14.1, or Electron >=12, with a React 18/19 view layer (minimal support for React 16.9+/17).

es.usage: Instale con `pnpm add @univerjs/presets @univerjs/preset-sheets-core` en un proyecto de navegador basado en Vite, cree un elemento contenedor, luego llame a `createUniver` con el preset Sheets Core y ejecute `univerAPI.createWorkbook({})` para renderizar una hoja de cálculo editable.

Las funciones se organizan en plugins de lógica de contenido y plugins de UI con dependencias declaradas explícitamente, dando a las funciones personalizadas límites claros y puntos de extensión consistentes.
es.cons: Ejecutarlo en entornos más antiguos o no estándar puede requerir un polyfill para `Intl.Segmenter`, y desarrollar el propio monorepo necesita Node.js >=22.18, mientras que el uso Headless necesita Node.js >=18.17.0, lo que sugiere que podría ser necesaria alguna configuración adicional del entorno según el objetivo. Además, los plugins comerciales del Web SDK, el Server SDK y las extensiones del AI SDK se distribuyen y licencian por separado, y la evaluación freemium incluye marcas de agua y límites de funciones.

content.goal: AG-UI is described as an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications, enabling integration between agents, real-time user context, and interfaces. The README positions it as complementary to MCP (which gives agents tools) and A2A (agent-to-agent communication), with AG-UI focused on bringing agents into user-facing applications.
content.usage: Getting started is documented as running `npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app` to scaffold a new application. Documentation is linked at https://ag-ui.com/, and an interactive Dojo of building-block examples is available at https://dojo.ag-ui.com/.
content.pros: The protocol defines roughly 16 standard event types and accepts a few simple compatible inputs, with a middleware layer that works with any event transport (SSE, WebSockets, webhooks) and loose event format matching for broad interoperability. Listed features include real-time streaming chat, bi-directional state synchronization, generative UI, and human-in-the-loop collaboration, plus a reference HTTP implementation to help teams start quickly.
content.cons: Several integrations are documented as still 'In Progress' rather than fully supported, including AWS Bedrock Agents, the OpenAI Agents SDK, and SDKs for Nim, Flowise, and Langflow, suggesting adopters may need to confirm current support status for a specific framework before relying on it.
content.fit: Given its stated role alongside MCP and A2A, and the 1st-party or partnership support from frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, and Google ADK, AG-UI appears suited to teams standardizing agent-to-interface communication across multiple backends. It is released under the MIT license.

ko.goal: AG-UI는 AI 에이전트가 사용자 대면 애플리케이션에 연결되는 방식을 표준화하는 개방형의 경량 이벤트 기반 프로토콜로 소개됩니다. 에이전트, 실시간 사용자 컨텍스트, 사용자 인터페이스 간의 통합을 지원하며, 문서에서는 도구를 제공하는 MCP 및 에이전트 간 통신을 담당하는 A2A와 상호 보완적인 관계로 설명되고, AG-UI는 에이전트를 사용자 대면 애플리케이션에 연결하는 역할을 맡습니다.
ko.usage: 시작 방법으로는 `npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app` 명령으로 새 애플리케이션을 생성하는 것이 안내되어 있습니다. 문서는 https://ag-ui.com/ 에서 확인할 수 있고, 구성 요소별 예제를 보여주는 Dojo는 https://dojo.ag-ui.com/ 에서 제공됩니다.
ko.pros: 프로토콜은 약 16종의 표준 이벤트 유형을 정의하고 몇 가지 단순한 호환 입력을 받아들이며, SSE, 웹소켓, 웹훅 등 어떤 이벤트 전송 방식과도 동작하는 미들웨어 계층과 느슨한 이벤트 형식 매칭을 통해 넓은 상호운용성을 지원합니다. 또한 실시간 스트리밍 채팅, 양방향 상태 동기화, 생성형 UI, 휴먼인더루프 협업 등의 기능과 빠른 시작을 돕는 참조 HTTP 구현이 제공됩니다.

zh-CN.goal: AG-UI 被描述为一个开放、轻量级的事件驱动协议,用于规范 AI 代理如何连接到面向用户的应用程序,支持代理、实时用户上下文与用户界面之间的集成。文档将其定位为与 MCP(提供工具)和 A2A(代理间通信)互补的协议,AG-UI 专注于将代理引入面向用户的应用。
zh-CN.usage: 文档中给出的入门方式是运行 `npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app` 来创建新应用。文档地址为 https://ag-ui.com/ ,展示各构建模块示例的 Dojo 位于 https://dojo.ag-ui.com/ 。

es.goal: AG-UI se describe como un protocolo abierto, ligero y basado en eventos que estandariza cómo los agentes de IA se conectan a aplicaciones orientadas al usuario, permitiendo la integración entre agentes, contexto de usuario en tiempo real e interfaces. La documentación lo presenta como complementario a MCP (que da herramientas a los agentes) y A2A (comunicación entre agentes), centrándose AG-UI en llevar agentes a aplicaciones orientadas al usuario.
es.usage: El inicio documentado consiste en ejecutar `npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app` para crear una nueva aplicación. La documentación está en https://ag-ui.com/ y el Dojo con ejemplos de bloques básicos está disponible en https://dojo.ag-ui.com/.
es.pros: El protocolo define alrededor de 16 tipos de eventos estándar y acepta unas pocas entradas compatibles simples, con una capa de middleware que funciona con cualquier transporte de eventos (SSE, WebSockets, webhooks) y una coincidencia de formato de eventos flexible que favorece una amplia interoperabilidad. Entre las funciones listadas están el chat en tiempo real con streaming, la sincronización bidireccional de estado, la UI generativa y la colaboración human-in-the-loop, además de una implementación HTTP de referencia para empezar rápido.
es.cons: Varias integraciones aparecen documentadas como en progreso en lugar de totalmente soportadas, incluyendo AWS Bedrock Agents, el OpenAI Agents SDK, y los SDKs de Nim, Flowise y Langflow, lo que sugiere que podría ser necesario confirmar el estado actual de soporte de un framework concreto antes de depender de él.
es.fit: Dado su rol declarado junto a MCP y A2A, y el soporte de primera parte o de socios de frameworks como LangChain, CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework y Google ADK, AG-UI parece adecuado para equipos que buscan estandarizar la comunicación entre agentes e interfaces a través de múltiples backends. Se distribuye bajo licencia MIT.

ja.goal: AG-UIは、AIエージェントがユーザー向けアプリケーションに接続する方法を標準化する、オープンで軽量なイベントベースのプロトコルとして説明されています。エージェント、リアルタイムのユーザーコンテキスト、ユーザーインターフェース間の統合を可能にし、ドキュメントではツールを提供するMCPやエージェント間通信を担うA2Aと補完的な関係にあるとされ、AG-UIはエージェントをユーザー向けアプリケーションに組み込む役割を担います。
ja.usage: 開始方法としては、`npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app` を実行して新しいアプリケーションを作成することが案内されています。ドキュメントは https://ag-ui.com/ にあり、構成要素ごとの例を示すDojoは https://dojo.ag-ui.com/ で公開されています。

content.goal: Plannotator is a local, browser-based review layer for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot CLI. It lets users annotate plans, specs, markdown, and HTML artifacts, review diffs and pull requests, and send feedback back to the agent.
content.usage: Install on macOS/Linux/WSL with `curl -fsSL https://plannotator.ai/install.sh | bash`, which sets up the `plannotator` binary plus per-agent hooks and slash commands. Use `/plannotator-review` to review uncommitted changes or a PR, `/plannotator-annotate <file>` to annotate a document, or `plannotator inbox` to open the review inbox.
content.pros: Plannotator integrates directly into agent workflows through plugins, hooks, and commands, and supports code review across Git, GitButler, Jujutsu, Perforce, GitHub, and GitLab. Plans can also be shared as links so teammates can give feedback.
content.cons: In remote mode the server listens on every network interface with no login required, so anyone who can reach the configured port can use it, even over an SSH tunnel; the documentation advises keeping that port closed to untrusted networks. Some agent integrations, such as Droid, currently support commands only, without plan interception.
content.fit: Plannotator likely suits developers and teams using multiple AI coding agents who want a shared, local review and annotation layer for plans, documents, and diffs, particularly those relying on version control systems beyond standard Git/GitHub, such as GitButler, Jujutsu, or Perforce.

content.goal: chrome-devtools-mcp is a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and CLI that lets coding agents (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, or Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser for automation, debugging, and performance analysis.
content.usage: Add an MCP client config that runs `npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest`, or install the package globally with `npm i chrome-devtools-mcp@latest -g` to use the `chrome-devtools` CLI (e.g. `chrome-devtools navigate_page`).
content.pros: It provides performance trace recording via Chrome DevTools, network/console inspection with source-mapped stack traces, and reliable automation through Puppeteer that waits for action results.
content.cons: The README states only Google Chrome and Chrome for Testing are officially supported, so other Chromium-based browsers may behave unpredictably; usage statistics are also collected by default unless explicitly disabled.
content.fit: This tool appears suited for developers integrating browser debugging and automation into AI coding agents, and requires Node.js LTS, a current stable Chrome, and npm.

content.goal: Open Code Review (ocr) is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originally developed internally at Alibaba Group. It analyzes Git diffs or full files via a configurable LLM-backed agent to generate structured, line-level review comments, and includes an `ocr scan` mode for reviewing entire codebases without relying on diffs.
content.usage: Install globally with `npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review`, then configure a provider with `ocr config provider` and `ocr config model`. Run `ocr review` to review workspace changes, `ocr review --from main --to feature-branch` for branch ranges, or `ocr scan` for full-file audits. Delegation mode lets a host coding agent (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code) perform the review using its own LLM instead.
content.pros: According to the README's benchmark (50 repositories, 200 pull requests, 10 languages, 1,505 annotated issues), Open Code Review reports higher precision and F1 than general-purpose agents like Claude Code on the same model, while using roughly 1/9 the tokens. Its design separates deterministic engineering (file selection, bundling, rule matching, positioning) from agent-driven dynamic decisions, aiming for more stable, predictable review quality.
content.cons: The tool requires Git 2.41 or later and, unless Delegation Mode is used, a separately configured and authenticated LLM provider before any review can run. The README also states that recall is deliberately lower than general-purpose agents, trading some missed issues for fewer false positives.
content.fit: Based on the documented features, it appears best suited to teams wanting automated, diff-aware code review integrated into CI/CD pipelines or coding-agent workflows, rather than as a replacement for broader general-purpose coding agents where higher recall matters more than precision.

zh-CN.usage: 使用 `npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review` 进行全局安装,然后通过 `ocr config provider` 和 `ocr config model` 配置 LLM 提供方。运行 `ocr review` 审查工作区变更,或使用 `ocr review --from main --to feature-branch` 审查分支范围,也可用 `ocr scan` 对整个文件进行审计。委托模式(Delegation Mode)允许 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Kimi Code 等宿主编码代理使用自身的 LLM 执行审查。
zh-CN.pros: 根据 README 中的基准测试(50 个仓库、200 个拉取请求、10 种编程语言、1,505 条标注问题),在使用相同底层模型的情况下,Open Code Review 相比 Claude Code 等通用代理报告了更高的精确率和 F1 值,同时消耗的 token 仅约为其 1/9。其设计将确定性工程(文件选择、打包、规则匹配、定位)与代理的动态决策分离,旨在实现更稳定、可预测的审查质量。

Analiza diffs de Git o archivos completos mediante un agente respaldado por un LLM configurable para generar comentarios de revisión estructurados a nivel de línea, e incluye un modo `ocr scan` para revisar bases de código completas sin depender de diffs.
es.usage: Instálalo globalmente con `npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review` y configura un proveedor con `ocr config provider` y `ocr config model`. Ejecuta `ocr review` para revisar los cambios del espacio de trabajo, `ocr review --from main --to feature-branch` para rangos entre ramas, o `ocr scan` para auditorías de archivos completos. El modo de delegación permite que un agente de codificación anfitrión (como Claude Code, Codex, Cursor o Kimi Code) realice la revisión con su propio LLM.
es.pros: Según el benchmark del README (50 repositorios, 200 pull requests, 10 lenguajes, 1.505 problemas anotados), Open Code Review reporta mayor precisión y F1 que agentes de propósito general como Claude Code usando el mismo modelo, consumiendo aproximadamente 1/9 de los tokens. Su diseño separa la ingeniería determinista (selección de archivos, agrupación, coincidencia de reglas, posicionamiento) de las decisiones dinámicas del agente, buscando una calidad de revisión más estable y predecible.
es.cons: La herramienta requiere Git 2.41 o superior y, a menos que se use el Modo de Delegación, es necesario configurar y autenticar por separado un proveedor de LLM antes de poder ejecutar cualquier revisión. es.fit: Según las funciones documentadas, parece adecuada para equipos que buscan integrar una revisión de código automatizada basada en diffs en pipelines de CI/CD o flujos de trabajo con agentes de codificación, más que como sustituto de agentes de propósito general en escenarios donde el recall importa más que la precisión.

content.goal: LoopForge, from Tencent, is a self-hosted workspace where teams ship software with coding agents. Users describe requirements to a chat-based Main Bot, which opens a Docker sandbox and delegates to project roles, or they run a saved SOP (a standard workflow of agents, scripts, and human approval gates) for repeatable delivery.
content.usage: Setup requires installing Git, cloning the repository, and running `./start.sh`, which pulls a pinned GHCR image and sets up MySQL and platform services; Docker, Compose, Python 3, and curl are checked and can be auto-installed. Afterward, users configure model API keys and GitHub authorization. LoopForge Local installs built-in workflows into an existing coding assistant via `npx -y loopforge-cli@latest install claude`.
content.pros: The platform supports ten coding-agent CLI executors, including CodeBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Cursor CLI, each configurable per role or conversation. SOPs give repeatable, staged delivery with built-in human approval gates, resumable runs, and node-level logs/artifacts. It runs under the MIT license on the user's own infrastructure.
content.cons: Default sandboxes rely on the host Docker socket, granting control of the host daemon, so this setup is described as suited for trusted teams rather than untrusted multi-tenant isolation. New installations also listen on all interfaces and allow team sign-up by default, so access configuration seems to need attention before internet exposure.
content.fit: LoopForge appears best suited for teams wanting shared, auditable delivery workflows with coding agents on their own infrastructure, needing Docker and Python 3 for the platform (or Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ for the Local edition). It is positioned as distinct from general-purpose automation builders like Dify, n8n, or Flowise.

ko.cons: 기본 샌드박스는 호스트 Docker 소켓에 의존하며, 이는 호스트 데몬에 대한 제어권을 부여하므로 문서에서는 이 구성이 신뢰할 수 있는 팀을 위한 것이며 신뢰되지 않는 다중 임차(multi-tenant) 격리용은 아니라고 설명합니다. 또한 신규 설치는 기본적으로 모든 네트워크 인터페이스에서 수신 대기하고 팀 가입을 허용하므로, 인터넷에 노출하기 전에 접근 설정에 주의가 필요할 것으로 보입니다.
ko.fit: LoopForge는 자체 인프라에서 코딩 에이전트를 활용한 공유되고 추적 가능한 전달 워크플로우를 원하는 팀에 적합해 보이며, 플랫폼 실행에는 Docker와 Python 3이, Local 에디션에는 Node.js 20+와 Python 3.8+가 필요합니다. Dify, n8n, Flowise와 같은 범용 자동화 빌더와는 구분되는 위치를 갖습니다.

zh-CN.goal: LoopForge 由 Tencent 提供，是一个自托管的工作空间，团队可借助编码代理来交付软件。用户在基于聊天的 Main Bot 中描述需求，系统会打开 Docker 沙箱并将任务分派给项目角色；也可以运行已保存的 SOP（由代理、脚本和人工审批关卡组成的标准工作流程）以实现可重复的交付。
zh-CN.usage: 运行 `./start.sh` 会拉取锁定在 GHCR 上的镜像，配置 MySQL 与平台服务，并检查 Docker、Compose、Python 3 和 curl，缺失组件可提示安装。启动后需配置模型 API 密钥和 GitHub 授权。较轻量的 LoopForge Local 选项可通过 `npx -y loopforge-cli@latest install claude` 将内置工作流安装到现有的编码助手中。
zh-CN.pros: 该平台支持十种编码代理 CLI 作为执行器，包括 CodeBuddy、Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Cursor CLI，可按角色或对话单独配置。SOP 提供带有内置人工审批关卡、可恢复运行以及节点级日志和产物的可重复分阶段交付。平台以 MIT 许可证发布，运行在用户自有基础设施上。
zh-CN.cons: 默认沙箱依赖主机的 Docker 套接字，这会赋予对主机守护进程的控制权，因此文档说明该配置适用于可信团队，而非不可信的多租户隔离场景。新安装默认在所有网络接口上监听并允许团队成员注册，因此在对外暴露到互联网之前，访问配置似乎需要额外注意。
zh-CN.fit: LoopForge 似乎更适合希望在自有基础设施上使用编码代理实现共享、可追溯交付工作流的团队，平台运行需要 Docker 和 Python 3，Local 版本则需要 Node.js 20+ 和 Python 3.8+。文档将其定位为与 Dify、n8n 或 Flowise 等通用自动化构建工具不同的产品。

es.goal: LoopForge, de Tencent, es un espacio de trabajo autoalojado donde los equipos entregan software con agentes de codificación. Los usuarios describen requisitos a un Main Bot basado en chat, que abre un sandbox de Docker y delega en roles del proyecto, o ejecutan un SOP guardado (un flujo de trabajo estándar de agentes, scripts y puntos de aprobación humana) para una entrega repetible.
es.usage: Al ejecutar `./start.sh` se descarga la imagen fijada en GHCR, se configuran MySQL y los servicios de la plataforma, y se verifica Docker, Compose, Python 3 y curl, ofreciendo instalar componentes faltantes. Después del arranque se configuran las claves de API del modelo y la autorización de GitHub. La opción más ligera LoopForge Local instala flujos integrados en un asistente de codificación existente con `npx -y loopforge-cli@latest install claude`.
es.pros: La plataforma admite diez CLI de agentes de codificación como ejecutores, incluyendo CodeBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode y Cursor CLI, configurables por rol o conversación. Los SOP ofrecen entregas repetibles por etapas con puntos de aprobación humana integrados, ejecuciones reanudables y registros/artefactos por nodo. Se distribuye bajo licencia MIT y se ejecuta en la infraestructura propia del usuario.
es.cons: Los sandboxes predeterminados dependen del socket de Docker del host, lo que otorga control del daemon del host, por lo que la documentación describe esta configuración como adecuada para equipos de confianza y no para aislamiento multiinquilino no confiable. Además, las instalaciones nuevas escuchan en todas las interfaces de red y permiten el registro de equipo de forma predeterminada, por lo que la configuración de acceso parece necesitar atención antes de exponerla a internet.
es.fit: LoopForge parece adecuado para equipos que buscan flujos de entrega compartidos y trazables con agentes de codificación sobre su propia infraestructura, requiriendo Docker y Python 3 para la plataforma, o Node.js 20+ y Python 3.8+ para la edición Local. Se posiciona como distinto de constructores de automatización de propósito general como Dify, n8n o Flowise.

ja.goal: Tencentが提供するLoopForgeは、コーディングエージェントを使ってチームがソフトウェアを開発するセルフホスト型のワークスペースです。ユーザーはチャット形式のMain Botに要件を伝えるとDockerサンドボックスが開かれプロジェクトロールに処理が委任され、保存されたSOP（エージェント、スクリプト、人間による承認ゲートで構成される標準ワークフロー）を実行して再現可能な配信を行うこともできます。
ja.usage: `./start.sh`を実行するとGHCRに固定されたイメージを取得してMySQLとプラットフォームサービスを構成し、Docker、Compose、Python 3、curlを確認して不足分の導入を提案します。起動後はモデルのAPIキーとGitHub認証を設定します。より軽量なLoopForge Localオプションは`npx -y loopforge-cli@latest install claude`で既存のコーディングアシスタントに組み込みワークフローを導入します。
ja.pros: 本プラットフォームはCodeBuddy、Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Cursor CLIなど10種類のコーディングエージェントCLIを実行役として対応し、ロールや会話ごとに個別設定が可能です。SOPは組み込みの人間承認ゲート、再開可能な実行、ノード単位のログとアーティファクトにより、段階的で再現可能な配信を提供します。MITライセンスのもと、ユーザー自身のインフラ上で動作します。
ja.cons: 既定のサンドボックスはホストのDockerソケットに依存しており、これによりホストデーモンの制御権が与えられるため、文書ではこの構成は信頼できるチーム向けであり、信頼されないマルチテナント分離向けではないと説明されています。また新規インストールは既定で全ネットワークインターフェースで待ち受け、チームへの登録を許可するため、インターネットに公開する前にアクセス設定への注意が必要と考えられます。
ja.fit: LoopForgeは、自前のインフラ上でコーディングエージェントを用いた共有・追跡可能な配信ワークフローを求めるチームに適していると考えられ、プラットフォームの実行にはDockerとPython 3が、Local版にはNode.js 20+とPython 3.8+が必要です。Dify、n8n、Flowiseのような汎用自動化ビルダーとは異なる位置付けとされています。

content.goal: ggml is presented as a tensor library for machine learning whose main goal is to be simple, portable, and efficient with minimal setup.
content.usage: The README's Quick start shows building from source with `git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml`, then `cd ggml`, `mkdir build && cd build`, `cmake ..`, and `cmake --build . --config Release -j 8`. A minimal, commented example (matrix multiplication) is referenced in examples/simple.
content.pros: Documented features include a plain C/C++ implementation without dependencies, cross-platform support (x86, ARM, RISC-V, LoongArch, PowerPC, s390x, WebAssembly), SIMD-optimized kernels, broad backend support (CPU, GPU, NPU, browser), 2- to 8-bit integer quantization plus MXFP4 and NVFP4 microscaling formats, and zero memory allocations during runtime.
content.cons: The README notes that changes to the core ggml library, including the CMake build system, should be proposed as pull requests to the separate llama.cpp repository rather than here, which may indicate that direct core contributions to this repo are routed through that external project's review process.
content.fit: Given its dependency-free C/C++ design and wide hardware coverage, ggml appears best suited to developers building or embedding machine learning inference across varied platforms, though the README does not specify particular application domains.

content.goal: claude-bughunter is a skill bundle for the Claude Code skills system aimed at bug bounty hunting and external red-team engagements. It bundles 83 skills, 15 slash commands, and patterns drawn from 681 disclosed HackerOne reports across 24 vulnerability classes, suggesting it is intended to give Claude Code structured, pattern-based guidance rather than general security chat.
content.usage: Install via Claude Code's plugin system with /plugin marketplace add elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter followed by /plugin install claude-bughunter@elementalsouls, or clone the repository with git clone https://github.com/elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter.git and run bash scripts/install.sh (macOS/Linux) or pwsh ./scripts/install.ps1 (Windows). Skills load automatically based on plain-English descriptions of the task, without needing to be invoked by name.
content.pros: The bundle covers a four-layer workflow (methodology, web-app hunting, enterprise-platform attack chains, and reporting/evidence hygiene) and documents support across multiple agent harnesses, including Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent, and Google AntiGravity, which suggests broader portability than a Claude-only tool.
content.cons: By design, the bundle excludes internal Active Directory attacks, C2 frameworks, post-exploitation/persistence techniques, and evasion, so it does not cover engagement phases past the external perimeter. The README also notes that Anthropic's runtime safeguards can block vulnerability-exploitation requests by default even for authorized work, which may affect usability in some sessions.
content.fit: This bundle appears suited to users doing authorized bug-bounty, web-application pentesting, or external red-team work who want structured, pattern-based tooling inside Claude Code, rather than teams needing internal AD, C2, or post-exploitation coverage, which the documentation states is deliberately out of scope.

es.goal: claude-bughunter es un paquete de skills para el sistema de skills de Claude Code, orientado a la caza de bug bounties y al trabajo de red-team externo. Incluye 83 skills, 15 comandos de barra y patrones extraídos de 681 informes divulgados de HackerOne en 24 clases de vulnerabilidad, lo que sugiere que su propósito es dar a Claude Code una guía estructurada basada en patrones en lugar de un chat de seguridad genérico.
es.usage: Se instala mediante el sistema de plugins de Claude Code ejecutando /plugin marketplace add elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter y luego /plugin install claude-bughunter@elementalsouls, o clonando el repositorio con git clone https://github.com/elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter.git y ejecutando bash scripts/install.sh (macOS/Linux) o pwsh ./scripts/install.ps1 (Windows). Las skills se cargan automáticamente al describir la tarea en lenguaje natural, sin necesidad de invocarlas por nombre.
es.pros: El paquete cubre un flujo de trabajo de cuatro capas (metodología, caza en aplicaciones web, cadenas de ataque a plataformas empresariales e informes/higiene de evidencias) y documenta compatibilidad con varios entornos de agentes, entre ellos Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent y Google AntiGravity, lo que sugiere una portabilidad más amplia que una herramienta exclusiva de Claude.
es.cons: Por diseño, el paquete excluye ataques internos de Active Directory, frameworks de C2, técnicas de post-explotación/persistencia y evasión, por lo que no cubre fases que vayan más allá del perímetro externo. El README también señala que las salvaguardas en tiempo real de Anthropic pueden bloquear por defecto solicitudes de explotación de vulnerabilidades incluso en trabajo autorizado, lo que podría afectar la usabilidad en algunas sesiones.
es.fit: Este paquete parece adecuado para quienes realizan trabajo autorizado de bug bounty, pentesting de aplicaciones web o red-team externo y desean herramientas estructuradas basadas en patrones dentro de Claude Code, pero no tanto para equipos que necesiten cobertura de AD interno, C2 o post-explotación, que la documentación indica como explícitamente fuera de alcance.

ja.goal: claude-bughunterは、Claude Codeのスキルシステム向けに作られた、バグバウンティハンティングと外部レッドチーム業務を目的としたスキルバンドルです。83個のskills、15個のスラッシュコマンド、681件の公開済みHackerOneレポートから抽出されたパターン(24の主要な脆弱性クラスをカバー)を含み、一般的なセキュリティチャットではなく、構造化されたパターンベースのガイダンスをClaude Codeに提供することを目的としているとみられます。
ja.usage: Claude Codeのプラグインシステムを使い、/plugin marketplace add elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunterを実行後に/plugin install claude-bughunter@elementalsoulsで導入するか、git clone https://github.com/elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter.gitでリポジトリをクローンし、bash scripts/install.sh(macOS/Linux)またはpwsh ./scripts/install.ps1(Windows)を実行します。スキルは名前を指定して呼び出す必要はなく、テスト対象を平易な言葉で説明するだけで自動的にロードされます。
ja.pros: 本バンドルは、方法論、Webアプリハンティング、エンタープライズプラットフォーム攻撃チェーン、レポーティング/証拠衛生の4層ワークフローを扱い、Claude Codeに加えてOpenCode、Codex CLI、Hermes Agent、Google AntiGravityなど複数のエージェントハーネスで動作するとドキュメント化されており、Claude専用ツールより広い可搬性を持つ可能性があります。

ja.fit: 本バンドルは、Claude Code内で構造化されたパターンベースのツールを求める、承認済みのバグバウンティ、Webアプリケーションペネトレーションテスト、外部レッドチーム業務を行うユーザーに適しているとみられますが、ドキュメントが明示的に対象外としている内部AD、C2、ポストエクスプロイトのカバレッジを必要とするチームには適さない可能性があります。

content.goal: Modern Web Guidance is a set of skills that embeds web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data into coding agents, steering them away from legacy JavaScript patterns toward native web platform solutions. It covers areas like CSS, HTML, JavaScript APIs, performance, accessibility, and security guidance for AI-assisted coding workflows.
content.usage: Install interactively with `npx modern-web-guidance@latest install`, or try it without installing using `npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop"` to find guides, `retrieve <guide-id>` to fetch one, or `npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan .` to scan a codebase for legacy patterns. Alternative installers exist for Vercel Skills CLI, GitHub CLI, and specific coding-agent plugin systems.
content.pros: The project documents coverage of 250 modern web features and 203 real-world developer use cases, is stewarded by the Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and MDN teams, and reports eval results showing meaningful uplift in coding-agent task pass rates when guidance is applied versus unguided runs. Guides are described as token-efficient, pruned via evals against what models already know.
content.cons: By default, Google collects anonymous telemetry, including installation counts, calling agent name, guide retrieval IDs, and CLI search queries, though this can be disabled by setting the `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` environment variable. This suggests users should weigh the default telemetry collection against their privacy preferences before adoption.
content.fit: Given its CLI commands and plugin installers for tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, this project appears best suited for teams using AI coding agents that want curated, up-to-date web platform guidance injected into their context window, rather than for projects without agent-based workflows.

ko.usage: `npx modern-web-guidance@latest install` 명령으로 대화형 설치 마법사를 실행할 수 있으며, 설치 없이도 `npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop"`로 가이드를 검색하거나 `retrieve <guide-id>`로 가져오거나 `npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan .`로 코드베이스의 레거시 패턴을 스캔해 볼 수 있습니다. Vercel Skills CLI, GitHub CLI 등 다양한 코딩 에이전트용 대체 설치 방법도 제공됩니다.

ko.fit: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity 등 다양한 코딩 에이전트를 위한 CLI 명령과 플러그인 설치 방법을 제공한다는 점에서, 이 프로젝트는 컨텍스트 윈도우에 최신 웹 플랫폼 가이드를 주입하고자 하는 AI 코딩 에이전트 기반 팀에 적합해 보이며, 에이전트 기반 워크플로가 없는 프로젝트에는 적합성이 낮을 수 있습니다.

zh-CN.goal: Modern Web Guidance 是一套将 Web 平台专业知识、最佳实践和浏览器兼容性数据嵌入编码代理的技能集合。它引导编码代理远离旧版 JavaScript 模式,转向原生 Web 平台解决方案,涵盖 CSS、HTML、JavaScript API、性能、无障碍和安全等方面的指导。
zh-CN.usage: 可以通过 `npx modern-web-guidance@latest install` 运行交互式安装向导进行安装;无需安装也可尝试使用 `npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop"` 搜索指南、`retrieve <guide-id>` 获取指南,或 `npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan .` 扫描代码库中的旧版模式。此外还提供 Vercel Skills CLI、GitHub CLI 等多种针对不同编码代理的替代安装方式。
zh-CN.pros: 文档表明该项目覆盖 250 个现代 Web 功能和 203 个真实开发者使用场景,由 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 和 MDN 团队共同维护。评估结果仪表板显示,使用指南后编码代理的任务通过率相较未使用时有明显提升(uplift)。指南被描述为通过评估剔除模型已知内容,从而实现 token 高效。
zh-CN.cons: 默认情况下,Google 会收集匿名使用信息,包括安装次数、调用代理名称、指南检索 ID 和 CLI 搜索查询,用户可通过设置环境变量 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` 关闭该功能。这提示用户在采用前需权衡默认的遥测数据收集与自身隐私偏好。
zh-CN.fit: 鉴于该项目为 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 等多种编码代理提供了命令行工具和插件安装方式,它看起来更适合希望将经过筛选的最新 Web 平台指导注入上下文窗口的 AI 编码代理团队,而对没有采用代理化工作流程的项目适配性可能较低。

es.goal: Modern Web Guidance es un conjunto de skills que incorpora experiencia en la plataforma web, mejores prácticas y datos de compatibilidad de navegadores directamente en los agentes de codificación. Orienta a estos agentes a alejarse de patrones JavaScript heredados y adoptar soluciones nativas de la plataforma web, cubriendo áreas como CSS, HTML, APIs de JavaScript, rendimiento, accesibilidad y seguridad.
es.usage: Se instala de forma interactiva con `npx modern-web-guidance@latest install`, o puede probarse sin instalar usando `npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop"` para buscar guías, `retrieve <guide-id>` para recuperarlas, o `npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan .` para escanear un código base en busca de patrones heredados. También existen métodos de instalación alternativos mediante Vercel Skills CLI, GitHub CLI y plugins para distintos agentes de codificación.
es.pros: La documentación indica que el proyecto cubre 250 funciones modernas de la web y 203 casos de uso reales de desarrolladores, y está respaldado por los equipos de Chrome, Edge, Firefox y MDN. Un panel de resultados de evaluación reporta mejoras (uplift) significativas en las tasas de éxito de tareas de agentes de codificación al usar la guía frente a no usarla. Las guías se describen como eficientes en tokens, depuradas mediante evaluaciones de lo que los modelos ya conocen.
es.cons: Por defecto, Google recopila información de uso anónima, incluyendo el número de instalaciones, el nombre del agente que realiza la llamada, los IDs de las guías recuperadas y las consultas de búsqueda de la CLI, aunque esto puede desactivarse configurando la variable de entorno `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1`. Esto sugiere que conviene sopesar la recopilación de telemetría por defecto frente a las preferencias de privacidad antes de adoptarlo.
es.fit: Dado que ofrece comandos de CLI e instaladores de plugins para agentes como Claude Code, Codex y Antigravity, este proyecto parece más adecuado para equipos que utilizan agentes de codificación con IA y desean inyectar orientación actualizada sobre la plataforma web en su ventana de contexto, resultando menos relevante para proyectos sin flujos de trabajo basados en agentes.

content.goal: SkillEvaluator is an NVIDIA tool that checks AI agent skills—folders of instructions and supporting files defined by the Agent Skills specification—and measures how they affect task results, starting with quality checks and then comparing runs with and without a skill. It is part of the NVIDIA Verified Skills pipeline.
content.usage: Install with `pip install skillevaluator` and run `skillevaluator validate ./my-skill --tiers 1` for Tier 1 checks without an API key. Alternatively, clone the repository with `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator.git` and use `uv run --python 3.13` to invoke tier-specific commands such as quality-check or rubric-eval.
content.pros: Tier 1 validation needs no API key and reports a deterministic score against a default passing threshold of 70. SkillEvaluator supports Python 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14, and can be added to GitHub or GitLab CI, or wired into skill-aware agents such as Claude Code and Codex.
content.cons: Tier 1 depends on external scanners (SkillSpector and Gitleaks, with Semgrep optional); if a required scanner cannot run, the check is marked INCOMPLETE and exits nonzero. Tier 3 live evaluation additionally requires provider access and a running sandbox (Docker by default), and usage can incur charges. The project carries an Experimental support level with no SLA.
content.fit: Given its tiered design and CI/agent integrations, SkillEvaluator appears best suited to teams building or maintaining Agent Skills-spec skills who want staged validation, deduplication checks, and optional live agent-impact evaluation, particularly within or alongside the NVIDIA Verified Skills ecosystem.

content.goal: This repository provides Anthropic's reference implementation of Skills for Claude — folders containing instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to perform specialized tasks such as document creation, data analysis, or workflow automation.
content.usage: Skills can be installed in Claude Code as a plugin marketplace via `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, followed by `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills` or `/plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`. They are also available directly to paid Claude.ai plans and through the Claude API.
content.pros: Many skills, including the docx, pdf, pptx, and xlsx document-handling skills that power Claude's document capabilities in production, are released under the Apache 2.0 open-source license, giving developers reusable examples of complex, actively used skills.
content.cons: The README states these skills are provided for demonstration and educational purposes only, and that actual Claude behavior may differ from what is shown, so users are advised to test skills thoroughly in their own environment before relying on them for critical tasks.
content.fit: This project appears best suited for developers seeking patterns and inspiration for building their own Claude skills rather than for teams needing a guaranteed production-ready toolset out of the box.

content.goal: Sherlock is a command-line tool documented as helping users search for social media accounts tied to a specific username across 400+ social networks.
content.usage: Installation can be done with `pipx install sherlock-project` (pip or uv are listed as alternatives), via Docker with `docker run -it --rm sherlock/sherlock`, or `dnf install sherlock-project`. To search, run `sherlock user123` for one username or `sherlock user1 user2 user3` for several; found accounts are saved to text files, and `sherlock --help` lists all available flags.
content.pros: The README lists multiple installation routes (pipx/pip/uv, Docker, dnf), export options in CSV and XLSX formats, proxy support via `--proxy`, and flags for filtering specific sites, adjusting timeouts, and controlling output verbosity.
content.cons: The documentation notes that third-party packages for ParrotOS and Ubuntu 24.04 are currently reported as broken, and that community-maintained packages for Debian, Ubuntu, Homebrew, Kali, and BlackArch are not directly supported or maintained by the Sherlock Project itself.
content.fit: Based on the documented features, this tool may be best suited for OSINT-style username enumeration on systems with Python/pipx or Docker available; it is currently at version 0.16.0 and distributed under the MIT license.

content.goal: agent-browser is a native Rust command-line tool that gives AI agents browser automation: it opens pages, reads them as an accessibility-style tree, and lets the agent act on elements from the shell. The core loop uses `snapshot`, which returns the page as compact text with a ref (e.g. `@e1`) per element; the agent acts on a ref, then re-snapshots to check the result.
content.usage: Install with `npm install -g agent-browser`, then run `agent-browser install` once to download Chrome for Testing. A documented quick start is: `agent-browser open example.com`, `agent-browser snapshot -i`, `agent-browser click @e1`, `agent-browser get url`, and `agent-browser close`.
content.pros: Beyond refs, the CLI also supports CSS selectors, text, XPath, and semantic locators (e.g. `find role button`). It can drive multiple browser engines (Chrome for Testing by default, Lightpanda, Obscura) and cloud providers (Browserbase, Browserless, Browser Use, Kernel, AgentCore), and ships native binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
content.cons: A click is reported as failed rather than succeeding when the target element is hidden, disabled, outside the viewport, or covered by another element (e.g. a consent banner), requiring the agent to dismiss the obstruction and take a new snapshot before retrying. Building from source also requires Node.js 24 or later, pnpm 11 or later, and Rust.
content.fit: Given its stdio MCP server (`agent-browser mcp`) and documented integration guidance for Next.js/Vercel and eve agents, it appears aimed at AI-agent-driven browser automation pipelines, though teams without a Node/Rust toolchain may find source builds less convenient.

es.goal: agent-browser es una herramienta de línea de comandos nativa en Rust que ofrece automatización de navegador para agentes de IA: abre páginas, las lee como un árbol similar al de accesibilidad y permite actuar sobre elementos desde la shell. El bucle principal usa `snapshot`, que devuelve la página como texto compacto con un ref (por ejemplo, `@e1`) por elemento; el agente actúa sobre un ref y vuelve a tomar una snapshot para comprobar el resultado.
es.usage: Se instala con `npm install -g agent-browser` y luego, la primera vez, se ejecuta `agent-browser install` para descargar Chrome for Testing. Un inicio rápido documentado es: `agent-browser open example.com`, `agent-browser snapshot -i`, `agent-browser click @e1`, `agent-browser get url` y `agent-browser close`.
es.pros: Además de los refs, admite selectores CSS, texto, XPath y localizadores semánticos (por ejemplo, `find role button`). Puede controlar varios motores de navegador (Chrome for Testing por defecto, Lightpanda, Obscura) y proveedores en la nube (Browserbase, Browserless, Browser Use, Kernel, AgentCore), y distribuye binarios nativos para macOS, Linux y Windows.
es.cons: Un clic se reporta como fallido, en lugar de exitoso, cuando el elemento objetivo está oculto, deshabilitado, fuera del viewport o cubierto por otro elemento (como un banner de consentimiento), por lo que el agente debe retirar el obstáculo y tomar una nueva snapshot antes de reintentar. Compilar desde el código fuente también requiere Node.js 24 o posterior, pnpm 11 o posterior, y Rust.
es.fit: Dado que incluye un servidor MCP sobre stdio (`agent-browser mcp`) y guías de integración documentadas para Next.js/Vercel y agentes eve, parece orientado a flujos de automatización de navegador impulsados por agentes de IA, aunque los equipos sin un entorno Node/Rust podrían encontrar menos conveniente compilarlo desde el código fuente.

ja.goal: agent-browserは、AIエージェントにブラウザ操作機能を提供するネイティブRust製CLIです。ページを開き、アクセシビリティツリーに似たテキストとして読み取り、シェルから要素を操作できます。中心となるループは`snapshot`コマンドで、各要素に`@e1`のようなrefが付いたコンパクトなテキストとしてページを返し、エージェントはrefに対して操作を行い、再度snapshotを取って結果を確認します。
ja.usage: `npm install -g agent-browser`でインストールし、初回に一度だけ`agent-browser install`を実行してChrome for Testingをダウンロードします。ドキュメントに示されたクイックスタートは`agent-browser open example.com`、`agent-browser snapshot -i`、`agent-browser click @e1`、`agent-browser get url`、`agent-browser close`の順です。
ja.pros: refに加えて、CSSセレクタ、テキスト、XPath、セマンティックロケータ(例:`find role button`)にも対応しています。デフォルトのChrome for Testingに加え、Lightpanda、Obscuraなどのエンジンや、Browserbase、Browserless、Browser Use、Kernel、AgentCoreといったクラウドプロバイダーも利用でき、macOS、Linux、Windows向けのネイティブバイナリが提供されています。
ja.cons: 対象要素が非表示、無効化、ビューポート外、または同意バナーなど他の要素に覆われている場合、クリックは成功ではなく失敗として報告されるため、エージェントは覆っている要素を解消し新たにsnapshotを取り直してから再試行する必要があります。ソースからビルドするにはNode.js 24以上、pnpm 11以上、Rustが必要です。
ja.fit: stdio経由のMCPサーバー(`agent-browser mcp`)を備え、Next.js/VercelやeveエージェントとのインテグレーションがドキュメントされていることからAIエージェント主導のブラウザ自動化パイプライン向けのツールと考えられますが、Node/Rustのツールチェーンがない環境ではソースビルドがやや不便になる可能性があります。

content.goal: daily_stock_analysis is an AI-driven analysis system for watchlisted stocks across the A-share, Hong Kong, US, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan markets. It automatically runs daily analyses and pushes a 'decision dashboard' to channels such as WeCom, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or email.
content.usage: It can be deployed via GitHub Actions (fork the repo, configure Secrets for an AI model and a notification channel, then enable and run the workflow), or run locally/with Docker using `git clone https://github.com/ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.git && cd daily_stock_analysis`, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, and `python main.py`. A web interface starts with `python main.py --webui` and is reached at http://127.0.0.1:8000.
content.pros: It aggregates quotes, K-lines, technical indicators, news, filings, and fundamentals across six markets, offers 15 built-in Agent query strategies, and supports multiple push channels. It can run with zero configuration using built-in free data sources such as AkShare, Baostock, and YFinance.
content.cons: According to the README, the default free data sources are subject to upstream rate limits, interface changes, and network fluctuations, so stability is not guaranteed; for long-term scheduled or batch analysis, paid token-based sources such as Tushare or Longbridge are suggested instead.
content.fit: This project appears suited to individuals who want automated, multi-market daily stock summaries delivered via messaging apps or email without running their own server. The README explicitly states the project is for study and research only and does not constitute investment advice.

content.usage: Sure can be self-hosted via Docker or run locally for development: run `cp .env.local.example .env.local`, `bin/setup`, and `bin/dev`, then visit http://localhost:3000; optional demo data can be loaded with `rake demo_data:default`.

content.goal: OpenMausBot presents itself as an open-source alternative to Grok Bot, Meta Muse, OpenAI dots, and Cue by Manus. It lets a person run a roster of AI bots, each powered by a locally running Claude or Codex agent, as chat contacts with their own personality, model, computer, and connected apps.
content.usage: Pre-built downloads exist for macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu, or the project can be run from source with `git clone https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot && cd OpenMausBot`, `pnpm install`, then `pnpm dev:server` and `pnpm dev`. It can also be installed and launched from a terminal with `npm install -g openmausbot` followed by `openmausbot`, which requires Node 24+ and, for Linux, Ubuntu 24.04.
content.pros: Bots run on the user's own `claude`, `codex`, or `grok` CLI logins rather than a new account, keep data local, and can use 500+ connected apps through Composio. Risky actions such as shell commands surface as inline approval cards the user must allow or deny.
content.cons: Ubuntu support is explicitly labeled beta with listed capability limits, and Wayland-based local bot control stays disabled while issue #345 is unresolved. The Windows installer is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen flags it as unknown publisher, and the optional Boat cloud-computer service is paid after its trial period.
content.fit: Based on its stated requirements, OpenMausBot seems best suited to users who already have at least one agent CLI (claude, codex, or grok) installed and logged in, and who run macOS, Windows, or Ubuntu 24.04 x64 with Node 24+ and pnpm available for building from source.

content.goal: EGM (Elephant-Goldfish Model, https://egm.dev) is an open-source plugin for AI coding assistants. It develops software specifications with full project context (the 'Elephant' role), then has reviewers without that context (the 'Goldfish' role) examine drafts to surface unstated assumptions.
content.usage: Installation commands vary by agent: for Claude Code, run `claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model` then `claude plugin install egm@egm`. Skills are invoked with commands like `/egm-brainstorm`, `/egm-draft`, and `/egm-review`, or `/egm:egm-drift-report` to compare documents against source code.
content.pros: Goldfish reviewers examine drafts and referenced material without the prior conversation, which the README states helps expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. A drift-report skill flags divergence between saved documents and current source code.
content.cons: Goldfish reviews require a session able to create fresh subagents; otherwise EGM stops the review, and a review does not replace tests or human judgment. Command auto-completion also differs between agy CLI 1.4.10 and 1.4.8 (issues #220, #196), so keeping the `/egm:` prefix explicit may be safer across versions.
content.fit: The built-in workflow targets software specifications; other document types need reviewers chosen via `/egm-review-loop`, and bootstrap/drift reporting apply to software codebases. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it is explicitly not an officially supported Google product, suggesting limited official support.

El rol 'Elephant' redacta especificaciones de software con el contexto completo del proyecto, mientras que el rol 'Goldfish' revisa ese borrador sin conocer la conversación previa, con el fin de exponer suposiciones no declaradas.
es.usage: Los comandos de instalación varían según el agente: en Claude Code se ejecuta `claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model` y luego `claude plugin install egm@egm`. es.pros: Los revisores Goldfish examinan el borrador y el material referenciado sin la conversación previa, lo que según el README ayuda a exponer suposiciones no declaradas y puntos ciegos. También incluye una habilidad de drift-report que señala divergencias entre documentos guardados y el código fuente actual.
es.cons: Las revisiones Goldfish requieren una sesión capaz de crear subagentes nuevos; si no, EGM detiene la revisión, y una revisión no sustituye a las pruebas ni al juicio humano. El README también indica que el comportamiento de autocompletado difiere entre agy CLI 1.4.10 y 1.4.8 (incidencias #220, #196), por lo que mantener explícito el prefijo `/egm:` podría ser más seguro entre versiones.
es.fit: El flujo integrado de borrador y revisión está orientado a especificaciones de software; otros tipos de documentos requieren elegir revisores mediante `/egm-review-loop`, y las funciones de bootstrap y drift-report se aplican a bases de código de software. content.goal: MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact) is a general-purpose physics engine designed to support research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, and machine learning, focusing on fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment. It is maintained by Google DeepMind.
content.usage: MuJoCo provides a C API along with Python bindings. The native Python package can be installed via `pip install mujoco` (requires Python >= 3.11). Prebuilt binaries for Linux, Windows, and macOS are also available from the GitHub releases page, which the documentation recommends as the primary installation method.
content.pros: The runtime module is tuned for performance and operates on preallocated low-level data structures. It includes interactive visualization in both native desktop windows and web browsers, plus a wide ecosystem of first- and third-party bindings (Python, JavaScript/WebAssembly, C#/Unity, Swift, Java, Julia, Rust) and model converters (OpenSim, SDFormat, OBJ, Onshape).
content.cons: Building from source is documented as an alternative to prebuilt binaries, but the tip of the `main` branch may be unstable. Prebuilt Linux wheels target the `manylinux2014` standard, which may limit compatibility with some older or non-standard distributions.
content.fit: MuJoCo appears well suited for researchers and developers needing high-performance articulated-body simulation, though the README notes it is not an officially supported Google product, suggesting production use may warrant additional caution.

content.goal: Hallmark is a design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode, made by Together AI and documented at https://www.usehallmark.com. It aims to generate web pages that avoid common visual tells associated with AI-generated design, applying a baseline of checks before building a page.
content.usage: Install with `npx skills add nutlope/hallmark -g`. Invoked harnesses can run commands such as `/hallmark redesign <path>` or `/hallmark audit <path>`, or a described build request, depending on the tool.
content.pros: The project offers fifty selectable themes plus a custom design mode, dedicated redesign and audit commands, 755 openly licensed credited photographs, and an automated lint pass (sloplint) checking pages against known AI-style design tells.
content.cons: The tool requires Node 18 or later, and its browser-based checks (such as rendering and screenshots) need an additional global install of puppeteer-core plus Chrome; without these, only static checks run.
content.fit: Hallmark appears best suited to teams already using Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, or OpenCode, since it integrates as a skill or plugin within those harnesses rather than as a standalone application.

content.goal: security-audit is a skill that turns a coding agent into a security auditor, running audits through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. It is the single-repo starting point from which Cloudflare's multi-stage vulnerability discovery harness evolved.
content.usage: Install via the Skills CLI with `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` (add `--global` for a user-level install). Inside the codebase to audit, ask the coding agent to run a request such as `security audit this codebase`; an unspecified output directory defaults to `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`.
content.pros: The workflow uses adversarial validation, where the agent that verifies a finding is never the one that found it, and produces three distinct verdicts (confirmed, needs_validation, rejected) validated against a schema. Cloudflare's test runs reportedly found a single run caught roughly half the vulnerabilities that repeated runs found in total, since ledgers and findings are additive across runs.
content.cons: Executing target code (builds, tests, fuzzers) requires an OS-enforced sandbox that disables external networking, uses a sanitized allowlisted environment, enforces resource limits, and restricts writes to scratch paths; without it, leads reportedly stay marked needs_validation rather than being executed. This suggests full use of the skill may be difficult without existing sandbox infrastructure.
content.fit: Given the sandboxing, Node.js, and parallel-sub-agent model requirements, the skill seems best suited to teams already using capable coding agents and willing to invest in isolated execution environments, rather than serving as a lightweight, drop-in audit tool.

ko.usage: Skills CLI로 `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` 명령으로 설치합니다(사용자 수준 설치는 `--global` 추가). 그런 다음 감사할 코드베이스 안에서 코딩 에이전트에게 `security audit this codebase`와 같은 요청을 하면 되며, 출력 디렉터리를 지정하지 않으면 기본값은 `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`입니다.

zh-CN.goal: security-audit 是一个把编码代理变成安全审计员的技能，通过六个阶段进行审计：侦察、基于覆盖率的猎寻、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和目标中立的报告。它是 Cloudflare 多阶段漏洞发现框架演化而来的单仓库起点。
zh-CN.usage: 通过 Skills CLI 使用命令 `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` 安装（添加 `--global` 可进行用户级安装）。然后在要审计的代码库中，让编码代理执行类似 `security audit this codebase` 的请求；若未指定输出目录，默认路径为 `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`。
zh-CN.pros: 该流程采用对抗式验证，核实发现的代理绝不是发现该问题的代理，并生成 confirmed、needs_validation、rejected 三种不同判定结果，并按照模式进行校验。据报告，Cloudflare 的测试运行中，单次运行仅发现了多次重复运行总共发现漏洞数量的大约一半。
zh-CN.cons: 要实际执行目标代码（构建、测试、模糊测试等），需要一个操作系统级沙箱，该沙箱要禁用外部联网、使用经过清理的白名单环境、强制资源限制，并仅允许写入指定的临时路径；据说如果缺少这些控制，相关线索会保持在 needs_validation 状态而不会被执行。这似乎意味着，对于没有现成沙箱基础设施的团队，可能难以完整使用该技能。
zh-CN.fit: 考虑到对沙箱、Node.js 以及支持并行子代理的模型等要求，该技能似乎更适合已经使用具备相应能力的编码代理、并愿意投入搭建隔离执行环境的团队，而不太像是一个轻量级的即插即用审计工具。

es.goal: security-audit es una skill que convierte a un agente de codificación en un auditor de seguridad, ejecutando la auditoría en seis fases: reconocimiento, búsqueda guiada por cobertura, validación de candidatos, salida estructurada, verificación independiente de registros y reporte neutral respecto al objetivo. Es el punto de partida de un solo repositorio a partir del cual evolucionó el sistema de descubrimiento de vulnerabilidades de Cloudflare.
es.usage: Se instala con la Skills CLI mediante `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` (añadiendo `--global` para una instalación a nivel de usuario). Luego, dentro del código a auditar, se le pide al agente algo como `security audit this codebase`; si no se indica un directorio de salida, el valor predeterminado es `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`.
es.pros: El flujo utiliza validación adversarial, en la que el agente que verifica un hallazgo nunca es el mismo que lo encontró, y produce tres veredictos distintos (confirmed, needs_validation, rejected) validados contra un esquema. Según las pruebas de Cloudflare, una sola ejecución encontró aproximadamente la mitad de las vulnerabilidades que se hallaron en total tras ejecuciones repetidas.
es.cons: Ejecutar código del objetivo (compilaciones, pruebas, fuzzers) requiere un sandbox reforzado por el sistema operativo que deshabilite el acceso a redes externas, use un entorno restringido mediante lista blanca, aplique límites de recursos y solo permita escritura en rutas temporales asignadas; sin estos controles, según se indica, los hallazgos permanecen marcados como needs_validation en lugar de ejecutarse. Esto sugiere que podría ser difícil aprovechar la skill por completo sin una infraestructura de sandboxing ya existente.
es.fit: Dados los requisitos de sandboxing, Node.js y modelos que soporten subagentes en paralelo, la skill parece estar orientada a equipos que ya usan agentes de codificación capaces y están dispuestos a invertir en entornos de ejecución aislados, más que a ser una herramienta de auditoría ligera y lista para usar.

ja.goal: security-audit は、コーディングエージェントをセキュリティ監査者に変えるスキルで、偵察、カバレッジ主導のハンティング、候補の検証、構造化された出力、独立した記録検証、対象に中立なレポート作成という6段階で監査を実行します。これは Cloudflare のマルチステージ脆弱性発見ハーネスが発展する元となった、単一リポジトリの出発点です。
ja.usage: Skills CLI を使い、`npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` コマンドでインストールします（ユーザーレベルでのインストールには `--global` を追加）。その後、監査対象のコードベース内でコーディングエージェントに `security audit this codebase` のような指示を出します。出力先ディレクトリを指定しない場合、デフォルトは `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>` になります。
ja.pros: このワークフローは敵対的検証を採用しており、発見結果を検証するエージェントは発見したエージェントとは異なり、confirmed、needs_validation、rejected という3種類の判定をスキーマに従って出力します。Cloudflare のテスト実行では、1回の実行で発見された脆弱性は、複数回の実行を合計して発見された数のおよそ半分だったと報告されています。
ja.cons: ビルド、テスト、ファジングなど対象コードを実際に実行するには、外部ネットワークを無効化し、許可リスト化されたサニタイズ済み環境を使い、リソース制限を適用し、スクラッチパスへの書き込みのみを許可する OS レベルのサンドボックスが必要とされており、これがない場合、該当するリードは実行されずに needs_validation のままになるとされています。このことから、既存のサンドボックス基盤がないチームにとっては、このスキルを十分に活用しにくい可能性があります。
ja.fit: サンドボックス、Node.js、並列サブエージェントに対応したモデルといった要件を踏まえると、このスキルは軽量な即利用型の監査ツールというよりも、すでに十分な能力を持つコーディングエージェントを使い、分離された実行環境の構築に投資する意思があるチームに向いていると考えられます。

content.goal: T3 Code is described as an open-source control plane for coding agents, letting users run agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other ACP-compatible agents locally while controlling them from one interface across desktop, web, and phone.
content.usage: Installation is available via a desktop app download, package managers (e.g. brew install --cask t3-code, winget install T3Tools.T3Code), or a command-line install script (curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh), after which running t3 starts the server and opens the web app; npx t3@latest allows trying it without installing.
content.pros: The README states T3 Code uses the user's existing agent subscriptions rather than reselling tokens, supports switching models mid-thread, provides synchronized desktop/web/phone clients from one server, integrates git worktrees with built-in diff review and PR creation, and is MIT licensed.
content.cons: Using T3 Code requires at least one coding agent to already be installed and signed in separately (e.g. via claude auth login or codex login), so it does not function as a standalone agent on its own.
content.fit: Based on the README, T3 Code appears suited for developers who already use agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor and want a unified, remote-capable interface across machines via local network, Tailscale, or T3 Connect.

content.goal: Claude-Mem is a memory layer for coding agents that preserves context across sessions by running a second observer agent that records tool activity, so the next session does not start from zero.
content.usage: Install with `npx claude-mem install`, which detects supported agents on the machine and sets them up; alternatively, inside Claude Code run `/plugin marketplace add thedotmack/claude-mem` followed by `/plugin install claude-mem`, then restart Claude Code so context from prior sessions appears.
content.pros: A new session opens with a compact, layered index of past observations and loads full details only when needed, and content wrapped in `<private>` tags is described as never being stored.
content.cons: The README notes that installing via `npm install -g claude-mem` sets up only the SDK/library, without registering plugin hooks or the worker service, so the documented installer commands must be used instead for a working setup.
content.fit: The README describes support for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and 11 more agents, while Copilot CLI, Goose, Roo Code, Warp and Zed are said to support memory search only without recording sessions, so it likely fits best for users on the fully supported agent list.

content.goal: DeepTutor is presented as an agent-native learning workspace that connects tutoring, research, creation, and practice in one extensible system, under the tagline "Lifelong Personalized Tutoring."
content.usage: Install the full web app and CLI with `pip install -U "deeptutor[full]"`, then run `deeptutor init` to configure ports and a provider and `deeptutor start` to launch the backend and frontend; a Docker image is also available via `docker run ... ghcr.io/hkuds/deeptutor:latest`.
content.pros: It offers a choice of retrieval engines (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG) for knowledge bases, a three-layer inspectable memory system (L1/L2/L3), and the ability to consult live subagents such as Claude Code and Codex from within a chat session.
content.cons: Windows preview builds are unsigned and may trigger a SmartScreen warning, and the project's note that it is "actively recruiting maintainers" suggests the current maintainer team may be relatively small, which could affect issue response times.
content.fit: Given its modular installation, multi-user authentication options, and admin-oriented deployment controls, DeepTutor appears suited both to individual learners starting from the CLI or Docker quick-start and to administrators willing to configure shared, multi-user deployments.

content.goal: HyperFrames is documented as a free, open-source framework for converting HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can run locally via a CLI, be driven by AI coding agents through skills, or serve as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
content.usage: A typical local workflow is `npx hyperframes init my-video`, then `cd my-video`, `npx hyperframes preview`, and `npx hyperframes render`, which requires Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg. For Claude Code, the README describes installing the plugin with `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` followed by `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes`.
content.pros: Documented strengths include HTML-native authoring with no React requirement, no build step for previewing an `index.html` composition, deterministic rendering where the same input yields the same frames, and an Apache 2.0 license with no per-render fees.
content.cons: Cloning the full repository for development requires Git LFS, since golden regression-test baselines under `packages/producer/tests` include about 240 MB of `.mp4` files; a source-only clone can skip this content using `GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1`.
content.fit: The project appears best suited to teams or agents comfortable authoring in plain HTML/CSS who want deterministic, CI-friendly video rendering, since the README contrasts it with Remotion's React-based authoring model as the main difference between the two tools.

zh-CN.goal: 根据文档，HyperFrames 是一个免费的开源框架，用于将 HTML、CSS、媒体以及可寻址（seekable）的动画转换为确定性（deterministic）的 MP4 视频。它可以通过 CLI 在本地运行，也可以通过 skills 由 AI 编码代理驱动，或作为托管创作工作流背后的渲染核心。
zh-CN.usage: 典型的本地工作流程是先运行 `npx hyperframes init my-video`，然后依次执行 `cd my-video`、`npx hyperframes preview`、`npx hyperframes render`，该过程需要 Node.js 22+ 和 FFmpeg。对于 Claude Code，README 描述了通过 `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` 以及随后的 `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes` 安装插件的方法。

es.goal: Según la documentación, HyperFrames es un framework de código abierto y gratuito para convertir HTML, CSS, medios y animaciones navegables (seekable) en vídeos MP4 deterministas. Puede ejecutarse localmente mediante una CLI, ser utilizado por agentes de codificación de IA a través de skills, o actuar como núcleo de renderizado detrás de flujos de trabajo alojados.
es.usage: Un flujo de trabajo local típico consiste en ejecutar `npx hyperframes init my-video`, luego `cd my-video`, `npx hyperframes preview` y `npx hyperframes render`, lo cual requiere Node.js 22+ y FFmpeg. Para Claude Code, el README describe instalar el plugin con `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` seguido de `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes`.
es.pros: Entre las ventajas documentadas se incluyen la autoría nativa en HTML sin requerir React, la ausencia de un paso de compilación para previsualizar una composición `index.html`, un renderizado determinista en el que la misma entrada produce los mismos fotogramas, y una licencia Apache 2.0 sin tarifas por renderizado.
es.cons: Clonar el repositorio completo para desarrollo requiere Git LFS, ya que las líneas base de pruebas de regresión bajo `packages/producer/tests` incluyen alrededor de 240 MB de archivos `.mp4`; una clonación solo de código fuente puede omitir ese contenido con `GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1`.
es.fit: El proyecto parece encajar mejor con equipos o agentes cómodos escribiendo HTML/CSS plano que buscan un renderizado determinista y apto para CI, dado que el README contrasta esto con el modelo de autoría basado en componentes React de Remotion como la diferencia principal entre ambas herramientas.

ja.goal: ドキュメントによると、HyperFramesはHTML、CSS、メディア、シーク可能なアニメーションを決定論的なMP4動画に変換するための無料のオープンソースフレームワークです。CLIを使ってローカルで実行することも、skillsを通してAIコーディングエージェントから利用することも、ホスティングされた制作ワークフローの背後にあるレンダリングコアとして使うこともできます。
ja.usage: 典型的なローカルワークフローは、`npx hyperframes init my-video` を実行した後に `cd my-video`、`npx hyperframes preview`、`npx hyperframes render` を続けるもので、Node.js 22+ と FFmpeg が必要です。Claude Codeの場合、READMEでは `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` に続けて `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes` でプラグインをインストールする方法が説明されています。
ja.pros: 文書化されている利点として、Reactを必要としないHTMLネイティブな記述方法、`index.html` 構成をプレビューする際にビルドステップが不要であること、同じ入力が常に同じフレームを生成する決定論的なレンダリング、そしてレンダリングごとの料金がないApache 2.0ライセンスが挙げられています。

content.goal: Claude SEO is described as a free, open-source SEO audit plugin for Claude Code that, given a website, runs a full SEO audit in 10 to 15 minutes covering technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, E-E-A-T content quality, Schema.org structured data, AI search (GEO), and local and e-commerce SEO, then produces a prioritized action plan.
content.usage: Inside Claude Code, it is installed by running `/plugin marketplace add AgriciDaniel/claude-seo`, `/plugin install claude-seo@agricidaniel-claude-seo`, and `/seo setup` in order; audits are then run with commands such as `/seo audit <url>`.
content.pros: The README states the tool is built from 29 sub-skills and 20 specialist agents, with up to 17 agents able to work on a site in parallel, is free with no per-site pricing or usage limits, and saves reports locally as Markdown, PDF, and JSON files.
content.cons: According to the README, a full `/seo audit` uses more of a user's Claude plan because five agents run on Opus; without optional Google API keys, Core Web Vitals are lab estimates and indexing is inferred from the page, and pages requiring scrolling or clicking can produce noisy results.
content.fit: The README positions the tool for SEO agencies seeking recurring audits, in-house SEO teams at SaaS, publishing, or e-commerce companies, and freelance SEO consultants who want to show audit results before writing a proposal.

content.goal: Taste Skill (`tasteskill 2.5.1`) is an Agent Skill that directs coding agents to build professional company websites, aiming for a figma.com/x.ai level of design rather than generic landing pages, by enforcing rules such as one design system, real photographs and brand icons, and shader effects reserved for tech, gaming and software pages.
content.usage: Install with `npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill "design-taste-frontend"` using the npx skills CLI. Users then ask their coding agent to build or redesign a company site; the skill classifies the business type and runs scripts such as `node scripts/start.mjs deal --page software` from the project folder to deal layout tokens before the page is checked.
content.pros: The skill verifies every build in a real headless-Chrome browser via a checker and finish gate before handing the page over, and it installs no extra dependencies or API keys itself, relying on bundled Wikimedia Commons photographs that work offline.
content.cons: Running it requires Node 22+ and an installed Chrome, Edge or Chromium browser as a prerequisite, with ffmpeg only optional for WebP output; the finish gate caps automatic fixing at three rounds, so some flagged issues may plausibly remain unresolved if they are not fixable within that limit.
content.fit: It appears best suited to teams already using agent-based coding tools like Claude Code or Codex, since it is distributed as a plugin/skill for those environments rather than a standalone web framework, and seems to favor company marketing/product sites over general-purpose application development.

es.pros: Cada construcción se verifica en un navegador Chrome headless real mediante un comprobador y una puerta de finalización antes de entregar la página, y no instala dependencias adicionales ni requiere claves de API, usando fotografías de Wikimedia Commons incluidas que funcionan sin conexión.

content.goal: Knowledge Work Plugins packages skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents into 11 role-specific plugins (e.g., sales, finance, legal, data) that aim to turn Claude into a specialist for a given job function, built for Claude Cowork and also compatible with Claude Code.
content.usage: Cowork users install plugins from claude.com/plugins/. Claude Code users first run `claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins`, then `claude plugin install sales@knowledge-work-plugins` (substituting the desired plugin); once installed, skills activate automatically and slash commands like `/sales:call-prep` become available.
content.pros: Each plugin bundles domain skills that Claude draws on automatically, explicit slash commands, and MCP connectors to external tools; every component is file-based (markdown and JSON), requiring no code, infrastructure, or build steps.

content.fit: Appears suited to teams or companies wanting to tailor Claude to their own tools, terminology, and processes across functions like sales, finance, legal, or data, using Claude Cowork or Claude Code.

content.goal: video-shotcraft is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns a product description into a finished promotional video. It captures real pages/screenshots, selects shots from a library of motion recipes, storyboards the film, animates it with Remotion, syncs it to a beat, adds sound design, and performs frame QA before delivering an editable MP4.
content.usage: Install by asking the agent 'Install this skill for me: https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft', via the skills CLI with `npx skills add Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft`, or by cloning `git clone https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft.git` and symlinking into the Claude Code or Codex skills folder. Usage requires no explicit command; describing the desired film (e.g. 'Use video-shotcraft to make a promo for my product.') triggers the agent.
content.pros: The library documents 124 recipe cards covering 150 shots across 10 categories, searchable in an online Gallery. Delivered output also includes a Remotion source project, a post-delivery Motion Workbench browser editor for retiming/swapping shots, and an optional JianYing (CapCut CN) draft export with per-shot clips and audio tracks.
content.cons: Rendering depends on several tools — Node.js/npm, ffmpeg/ffprobe, uv for BGM beat analysis, and puppeteer for page capture — and is documented as tested on macOS, with headless Linux requiring extra flags such as a concurrency cap, a chrome-headless-shell binary, and a custom browser executable path when the CDN is blocked.
content.fit: This suits teams already using Claude Code or Codex who want promo videos generated from their own real screenshots and copy rather than AI-generated video; it is explicitly described as not a video generator, producing code-based, editable frames instead.

es.goal: video-shotcraft es una habilidad para Claude Code y Codex que convierte una descripción de producto en un video promocional terminado. Captura páginas reales, elige tomas de una biblioteca de recetas de movimiento, hace el storyboard del video, lo anima con Remotion, lo sincroniza al ritmo, añade diseño de sonido y realiza control de calidad por fotograma antes de entregar un MP4 editable.
es.usage: Se puede instalar pidiéndole al agente 'Install this skill for me: https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft', mediante el CLI de skills con `npx skills add Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft`, o clonando con `git clone https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft.git` y enlazándolo a la carpeta de skills de Claude Code o Codex. No se necesita un comando específico: basta con describir el video deseado (por ejemplo, 'Use video-shotcraft to make a promo for my product.') para que el agente actúe.
es.pros: La biblioteca documenta 124 tarjetas de receta que cubren 150 tomas en 10 categorías, buscables en una Gallery en línea. La entrega incluye también un proyecto fuente de Remotion, un editor de navegador Motion Workbench para retemporizar o intercambiar tomas tras la entrega, y una exportación opcional de borrador JianYing (CapCut CN) con clips por toma y pistas de audio.
es.cons: El renderizado depende de varias herramientas —Node.js/npm, ffmpeg/ffprobe, uv para el análisis de ritmo de la música y puppeteer para la captura de páginas— y se documenta como probado en macOS, mientras que en Linux sin interfaz gráfica se requieren parámetros adicionales como un límite de concurrencia, un binario chrome-headless-shell y una ruta de ejecutable de navegador personalizada cuando el CDN está bloqueado.
es.fit: Parece adecuado para equipos que ya usan Claude Code o Codex y desean generar videos promocionales a partir de sus propias capturas de pantalla y textos reales, en lugar de video generado por IA. Se aclara explícitamente que no es un generador de video, sino que produce fotogramas editables dibujados por código.

ja.fit: すでにClaude CodeやCodexを使用しており、AI生成映像ではなく自社の実際のスクリーンショットやコピーをもとにプロモーション映像を作りたいチームに向いていると考えられます。これは『ビデオジェネレーターではない』と明記されており、コードによって描かれる編集可能なフレームを生成するものだと説明されています。
